fixtures.title: Fixture workspaces
fixtures.subtitle: Materialize incomplete fixture packs into an isolated directory. This never writes ~/.codex. The GUI only calls CLI scaffold.
fixtures.workspaceHint: Leave empty for ~/.codex-fixture-workspace. Cannot point at .codex.
fixtures.workspacePlaceholder: Leave empty for the default isolated directory
fixtures.force: Overwrite an existing directory whose fingerprint no longer matches
fixtures.previewStale: The pack or directory changed; preview again.
fixtures.previewOnly: Preview only; confirm to write or delete.

scenarios.title: Scenario library
scenarios.subtitle: Deploy, inspect, uninstall, and recover target-local scenario packages. GUI never writes those files itself.
scenarios.targetHint: Must be an explicit absolute directory. Writes stay preview-first until you confirm.
scenarios.previewStale: The scenario selection or target changed. Preview again before confirming.
scenarios.timedOut: The scenario operation timed out. Check the refreshed target status and preview recovery before retrying if recovery is required.
scenarios.packageBlockers: This package is blocked on this machine
scenarios.pickPackage: Select a package from the library
scenarios.needTarget: Choose a target directory to inspect deployments.

manage.title: Manage
manage.subtitle: Uninstall, restore hooks, recover interrupted transactions. Every operation previews first and requires confirmation.
manage.uninstallDesc: Reverts deployment layers per manifest; repeated uninstalls roll back layer by layer.
manage.restoreHooksDesc: Restores an isolated hooks.json.disabled back to hooks.json.
manage.recoverDesc: Recovers residue left by an interrupted deploy/uninstall.
manage.previewRequired: Preview first; execution unlocks after confirmation
manage.confirmUninstall: Confirm uninstall? This reverts the most recent deployment layer.
manage.exitQueued: An operation is running. The app will exit automatically when it finishes.
manage.exitGuardFailed: Close protection could not be registered. Keep the app open until the operation finishes.
manage.exitFailed: The app could not close automatically. Close it again after the operation finishes.
